tested_on: Docker Engine through tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy on the maintainer's docker hosts (lxc-dockerdev and lxc-docker1, 65 containers): an unhealthy container's last health-check output was read ('failed: Connection refused.') and shown in Netlens as the reason; healthy and exited containers carry no output
reviews.notes: Written with the assistant Claude. No new request, no new permission. Confirmed by the maintainer.
